title: ASIX Modpack
description: Create what you want with Create Mod & it's add-ons.
body:
# ASIX Modpack

Welcome to the **ASIX Modpack**, it's a modpack centered arround tinkering with the Create Mod and it's plugins.

- This Modpack includes Create mod & it's plugins.
- Generation mods such as Terralith.
- Optimization with sodium, lithium, FerriteCore, etc.
- Also, lots of decoration mods like Chipped, Handcrafted

There's much more content in the modpack, but this is just an overview of it.
